svg.title: Countries (States and Subnational Regions) and Their Positions on Vegetarian Diets in Food-Based Dietary Guidelines

cc:Work.dc:title: Countries (States and Subnational Regions) and Their Positions on Vegetarian Diets in Food-Based Dietary Guidelines
cc:Work.dc:description:
World map (Robinson projection) depicting the positions of countries (states and subnational regions) on vegetarian diets within their food-based dietary guidelines. Green ("Supporters") indicates countries emphasizing the health and/or ecological sustainability benefits of vegetarian diets, light green ("Informers") indicates countries providing neutral advice on vegetarian diets without emphasizing positive or negative aspects, orange ("Uninformed") indicates countries with no stance on vegetarian diets, red ("Critics") indicates countries that emphasize the risks associated with vegetarian diets and/or advising against vegan diets, grey ("No guidelines") indicates countries with no dietary guidelines available, dark grey ("Guideline not analysed") indicates countries where the guideline has not been analyzed.
Made with Flourish: https://public.flourish.studio/visualisation/16211821/
